title: Sixteen Nights: KL to Angkor
summary: New Year's Eve under the Kuala Lumpur skyline, five days of temples and canals in Bangkok, the mountain temples of Chiang Mai, and four days among the ruins of Angkor.
principles: Your own day-by-day plan is the backbone; every stop you planned is kept unless it is closed on the day it falls on.
Ideas you scored 7–9 were slotted in where they sit next to something you had already planned, so they add little travel time.
Ideas you scored 4 or lower were dropped. Ideas you scored 5–6 appear as optional stops or in the backup list.
Days are deliberately overbooked. Optional stops (dashed numbers) are the first things to cut.
Days were checked against weekday opening rules — for example Chatuchak and Chiang Mai's Coconut Market are weekend-only, and Bangkok's National Museum is closed Monday and Tuesday.
